content.text: Everyone, log in quickly, the event is starting!
@Pineapple I'm still downloading, this game is over 100GB! With such a large size, make sure to allocate enough space for the download in advance.
I created a character first, check out the beauty I made!
@Yuzu, you're so beautiful, just like a model!
@Pomelo, compare this beauty with the ancient god I sculpted, haha.
@Pineapple, I still remember that ancient deity of yours, it was really terrifying.
Please don't make fun of my beauty, she's my masterpiece.
But when it comes to character customization, @Pineapple, your ancient deity really has a unique personality, haha.
@Old Meng Are you saying her face is even worse than the ancient god I created? Haha.
Fortunately, my computer has high specs, so running at full graphics settings is no problem.
@Alex Really? Then let's see the screenshot effects in your game later.
@Pineapple, your dance moves in the game are quite unique too, haha.
This event is really great, everyone come and join us for dancing and taking photos together!
Let's go! I'll come find you guys once I'm in the game!
Haha, look at this ancient god I've sculpted—doesn't it have a unique charm?
@Pineapple This look definitely has a unique aesthetic, but compared to the gold card character in the game...
@Pineapple, this character is definitely unique in some ways and may not align with everyone's aesthetic standards.
@Pineapple @Pomelo I've finally finished downloading and am ready to enter the game. Pineapple's character is a bit like my patience during the download.
Everyone, take a look at this main city scene—it feels exactly like the setting from the movie!
@老孟 Yes, the details are very well done, and the overall atmosphere is faithfully recreated.
@老孟 @柚子 Indeed, it's quite good. The main city in the movie has a sense of magical realism.
I'm in! The main city is so cool, it's just like the scenes in the movies.
This is the main city from the movie. Look at the comparison; the game's recreation is quite impressive.
From the details, the main city in the game even surpasses the movie in terms of visual effects.
@Yuzu Indeed, especially in terms of lighting effects, the game performs even better.
@老孟 With my graphics card fully enabled, the game's visual quality is completely cinematic.
Since everyone is here, we should find a spot to take a group photo for keepsake.
@Pineapple Great idea! Let's all dance and take photos together in the game.
Look at this, I've set the graphics to the highest and turned on full ray tracing!
@Alex Your graphics card is really nice, I wonder if it will lag.
@Alex My setup can't handle it, so I have to lower the settings a bit.
Hey, I'm stuck in the wall here. Game bugs are everywhere!
@Pineapple This clipping is truly classic; I've encountered something similar before.
@Pineapple This bug is hilarious, haha, let me see if I can get stuck too.
@Pineapple, so your character is an Ancient God? It really does resemble the face you created.
Sigh, I went to do some draws, but all I got was junk, just blue skies and white clouds...
@Yuzu, drawing cards is all about luck. Don't be discouraged; you'll definitely get something good next time.
@Yuzu I've drawn a lot of trash too, you'll get used to it, haha.
@Yuzu, why don't we go to the main city first to take a photo together and relax a bit?
@老孟 Great idea, let's find a nice spot to take a photo together.
Everyone, come to the main city to gather, we're getting ready for a group photo!
Okay, I'll be right there!
Oh my, look at my luck!
@Alex Your luck is simply incredible! You should go buy a lottery ticket.
@Alex This gold card is really dazzling... but we still have to face reality and take a look at the character modeling.
Come take a look at the 3D modeling of this character—it feels a bit off.
@Yuzu This modeling is really both laughable and frustrating, not even as good as the ancient god I sculpted.
@Yuzu I thought the gold card would be more refined, but compared to this, it really does seem a bit broken.
@Pineapple, that's pretty harsh, but there's definitely some truth to it.
Don't rush, check out the high-definition version in the movie—this is the real visual treat.
@Yuzu The one in the movie is indeed much cooler; the one in the game falls a bit short.
@Yuzu, this is the so-called gap that leaves one feeling utterly helpless.
@老孟 Let's just look forward to the future updates; maybe there will be improvements.
I hope so. I'm also planning to take some nice screenshots in the game.
@Yuzu, let's find a nice spot for a photo together to capture this collaboration event.
Good idea, is everyone ready? Let's go to the main city for a group photo!
Look at this Easter egg, I wonder if anyone has ever noticed it?
@Pineapple, this seems to add details to the plot that weren't mentioned in the movie, right? I remember the film only mentioned a vague backstory.
@Pineapple I think the content of this letter is quite interesting, especially the mention of 'the secret of the main city'—could it be a foreshadowing for future plot developments?
@Yuzu It's indeed foreshadowing. I previously looked up some information, and the movie version didn't delve deeply into this setting. It seems the game aims to flesh out the world-building.
@老孟 You really know the background best! This part was indeed not mentioned in the movie, and it feels like there are many similar Easter eggs hidden in the game.
@Pineapple Next time we can organize a special Easter egg hunt event. These details are even more interesting than the main storyline!
@Alex Agreed! But let's take a group photo first, and then we can explore these Easter eggs later.
Alright, everyone gather for a group photo. Are you all ready with your poses?

meta.full_summary:
对话开始。
(第1段摘要): 菠萝召集大家上线参加活动，Alex抱怨下载时间长，柚子展示捏的美丽角色，各自调侃对方的捏脸作品，最终决定在游戏里合影。
(第2段摘要): 全员进入游戏并讨论场景还原度，准备合影。
(第3段摘要): 在讨论游戏画质设置和角色卡墙Bug后，柚子抽卡不佳，大家决定在主城合影。
(第4段摘要): Alex抽到金卡，全员对比游戏与电影角色建模的差距，计划在游戏主城合影留念。
(第5段摘要): 菠萝展示了一个游戏彩蛋书信，引发关于游戏补充电影设定的讨论；随后全员集合在游戏内摆造型准备合影，讨论菠萝的古神角色与其他人的造型形成强烈反差。
resolved_events: 大家进入游戏并开始互动
对比游戏角色与电影角色的差距
